title: Show complete live search context
changes: Include the bounded hit count, frame window, canonical RAM guard and on-hit action in the existing pending-search context.
Include the authenticated named trigger and full definition hash in pending search context.
validation: Focused Windows GNU/Wine tests passed. In an isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb session, the interactive console at a verified 480x360 Win32 client displayed the live request identity, progress and all extended search settings; exact-ID cancellation completed and the GUI closed normally. Input was simulated and protected inputs stayed unchanged.

A second 480x360 Wine/Xvfb console showed the named trigger and complete definition hash during the search and cancelled its exact request; protected inputs stayed unchanged and the GUI closed normally.
limitations: One live search and window size only; DBG2-15 operation parity, other long parameter cases, native Windows and physical input remain open.
